success.title: File Editor Disabled
success.details: The WordPress theme and plugin file editor is disabled, improving security.
steps: Use FTP or file manager for file edits

error.title: File Editor Enabled
error.details: The WordPress theme and plugin file editor is enabled, which poses a security risk.
steps: Use FTP or SFTP for file editing

learn_more.description: The WordPress file editor allows direct editing of theme and plugin files from the admin dashboard. While convenient, it can be exploited by attackers to modify your site's code if they gain admin access.
